title: auxemma oncocalyx
intro: Auxemma oncocalyx, commonly known as the "African Pygmy Periwinkle", is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids.
